spans.s: --of the moon, description of; sprang out of waters with ten horses, charioteer, etc., has three wheels. वा. ५२. ५०-4.
--a ग्रामणि with the sun in spring. वा. ५२. 4.
(I)--the यक्ष presiding over the month of Madhu. भा. XII. ११. ३३; Br. II. २३. 3.
(II)--one of the seven प्रानिन्स् of the king. वा. ५७. ७०, Br. II. २९. ७६.
(I)--with the sun in the months of शुचि and शुक्र (in the month of आषाढ वि। प्।). Br. II. २३. 7; Vi. II. १०. 8.
(II)--a ग्रामणि with the sun in summer. वा. ५२. 7. [page३-050+ २९]
--a यक्ष, who resides in the sun's chariot during the month of माधव. Vi. II. १०. 5.
--a जयादेव and son of ब्रह्मा; a man- त्रशरीर. Br.
(II)--a disciple of सत्यश्रिय; a शाख प्र- वर्तक, शाखपूर्णरथीतर (?). वा. ६०. २९, ६५.

king पुष्पवाहन belonged to this aeon.

to be heard on the श्राद्ध day;

--a यक्ष who resides in the sun's chariot in the months of Caitra and Madhu. Vi. II. १०. 3.

--a son of भीमरथ, and father of Nava- ratha;
1: Br. III. ७०. ४२.
adhered to dharma and satya.
2: वा. ९५. ४१-2.
--the Saptami of the month of माघ when the sun turns his chariot; fit for making gifts and per- forming श्राद्ध to please पितृस्. M. १७. 9-१०.
(I)--the यक्ष presiding over the month of शुक्र (in the sun's chariot during the month of शुचि- वि। प्।). भा. XII. ११. ३५; Br. II. २३. 7; Vi. II. १०. 7.
(II)--a ग्रामणि with the sun in the summer. वा. ५२. 7.

--a military title below महारथ
1: वा. ९९. २४९.
earned by ययाति and कार्तवीर्यार्जुन.
2: Br. III. ६८. २०; ६९. २१.
(I)--a son of पृषदश्व; had no issue and at his desire, Angiras blessed him with sons. Their descend- ants became Angirasas and क्षत्रोपेत dvijas. भा.

(II)--a pupil of सत्यशृण्ग--also शाखवैण; author of three सम्हितस् given to four pupils Paila and others; also author of Nirukta--a त्रयार्षेय, with Angiras and विरूप;
1: Br. II. ३४. ३२. ३५. 3; M. १९६. ३८; वा. ६१. 2.
had four disciples, Ketava, Dalaki, Dhama- शर्म and देवशर्म; all of them became murderers of Brahmanas on the death of their master; they approached the creator for light who advised them to make a visit to वालुकेस्वरम् to get redeemed of their sins by bath and prayer; on the completion of the pilgrimage they reached सूर्यमण्डलम्.
2: Ib. ६०. ६५-72.
(IV)--a राजऋषि who became a Brahmana and attained siddhi. वा. ९१. ११७.
--a यक्ष with the sun in the months of Madhu and माधव. Br. II. २३. 3.
